premarket.market_expectations: Neutral bias prevails as US equity futures decline sharply overnight while Indian markets closed in the top third of their range. Foreign investors were net buyers while domestic institutions sold. The rupee strengthened against the dollar, and oil prices fell significantly. Volatility edged higher slightly. With mixed global cues and normal conviction levels, markets may see cautious trading today.
